scope: 45 material assertions from 118420-byte user-supplied report (not entire file line-by-line certification); paired with first-party/court sources and evidence classification

claims.claim: Google crawl frontier uses multiple queues and politeness
claims.guardrail: Graph is only an architecture abstraction, not a deployment diagram.

claims.claim: Trawler takes Q* and P* recrawl signals exactly as drawn
claims.guardrail: No proprietary weights, policy or crawl override may be derived from this diagram.

claims.claim: Googlebot conditional ETag/304 reduces origin transfer
claims.guardrail: Conditional headers depend on crawler/request, no rank boost implied.

claims.claim: Cloud CDN migration can trigger origin cold-cache crawler surge
claims.guardrail: Must monitor host capacity and allow verified crawlers, not assume all zones same.

claims.claim: Googlebot JavaScript rendering means CSR-only content is safe everywhere
claims.guardrail: SSR/SSG meaningful core text is robust for diverse crawlers, not a guarantee of citation.

claims.claim: No AI crawler executes JavaScript
claims.guardrail: Behavior varies by product, experiment, fallback and change over time; test raw HTML.

claims.claim: Bingbot has same JS rendering results as Google WRS
claims.guardrail: Do not assume identical browser engines or rendering scheduling.

claims.claim: OAI-SearchBot and GPTBot roles are separate
claims.guardrail: ChatGPT-User user fetch distinct; robots preference and actual fetch not identical.

claims.claim: Modern search uses lexical and vector retrieval broadly
claims.guardrail: Public IR models do not reveal Google's complete 2026 production stack.

claims.claim: Exact Google Alexandria Base/Zeppelins/Landfills tier assignment for a URL can be inferred externally
claims.guardrail: Search Console cannot show internal tier or a website's Q*.

claims.claim: Google Ascorer exact 1000-candidate retrieval/rerank funnel
claims.guardrail: Document system names, not universal fixed candidate counts.

claims.claim: Q* is a quality-related top-level signal described in testimony
claims.guardrail: Court exhibit dated Jan 31 2025, does not give public optimization formula.

claims.claim: NavBoost uses a rolling 13 months of click data in court exhibit
claims.guardrail: No click-farm strategy, CTR boost coefficient or future invariant inferred.

claims.claim: Click rate or dwell manipulation breaks incumbent ranking inertia
claims.guardrail: Search click bias and anti-manipulation noted; optimize human task not fabricated clicks.

claims.claim: RankEmbed dual encoder and FastSearch were discussed in testimony
claims.guardrail: Do not assume all AI Mode/Gemini search products share a fixed public retrieval topology.

claims.claim: Static Q* is a hard quality ceiling and removing zero traffic pages directly raises Q*
claims.guardrail: Thin page review must be by user value and canonical/intent, not arbitrary zero-traffic pruning.

claims.claim: Google Chrome telemetry direct visitor increases guarantee SEO improvement
claims.guardrail: Branded demand and real traffic may correlate but no public controllable rank multiplier.

claims.claim: Google AI Mode links need Search index+snippet eligibility
claims.guardrail: Eligibility is not inclusion or citation guarantee.

claims.claim: RAG can mix BM25 and dense search, and RRF is one possible fusion
claims.guardrail: Illustrative 60-constant is not an AI Mode weight.

claims.claim: llms.txt required for Google AI visibility or rank
claims.guardrail: Google Search explicitly says it doesn't use llms.txt for Search features.

claims.claim: WebMCP/Lighthouse agentic scores are Google Search rank signals
claims.guardrail: Agent usability experiment != Search rank.

claims.claim: AI-generated shallow page variants for each fan-out query improve Google visibility
claims.guardrail: Google scaled content policy explicitly warns against this.

claims.claim: JSON-LD WebApplication guarantees AI citations
claims.guardrail: Structured data must match visible truth; may qualify for applicable rich results, not guaranteed AI citation.

claims.claim: Google information gain patent proves applied production weighting
claims.guardrail: A patent is not evidence any scoring term is active.

claims.claim: Discover wide images help eligibility where supported
claims.guardrail: No guarantee of Discover traffic or fixed thumbnails.

claims.claim: IndexNow pings automatically guarantee 15 to 45 minute Bing rank and ChatGPT citation
claims.guardrail: Protocol notifies search engines, does not force indexing or ranking.

claims.claim: AI referrals often lack source referrers
claims.guardrail: No universal 70% unlabeled traffic figure, capture unknown.

claims.claim: FreeConvert gets 51.03M visits/month
claims.guardrail: Estimated Oct 2026, not a verified freeconvert internal GA4 report.

claims.claim: FreeConvert >3000 landing pages proves mass generated pages work
claims.guardrail: Count and page uniqueness unverified in this pass; functional value must be audited.

claims.claim: No JSON-LD on FreeConvert causes missing Google AI citations
claims.guardrail: No special AI schema required; avoid copying unsupported remedy.

claims.claim: Astro has superior observed CWV population statistics vs some stacks
claims.guardrail: Framework cohorts differ in site complexity; benchmark our pages.

claims.claim: Cloudflare local website costs just $0.87 monthly at 100K conversions
claims.guardrail: External developer, support, domains, analytics, failovers, ad scripts and user battery excluded.

claims.claim: AdSense 2.60 USD RPM is predictable from FreeConvert estimates
claims.guardrail: Revenue requires actual account and pageviews, fill, geography and invalid traffic.

claims.claim: Google-Extended and Googlebot serve different purposes
claims.guardrail: 2026 AIPREF/shared AI token interplay must be verified before edits.

claims.claim: llms.txt + WebMCP + NLWeb + A2A universally needed for ranking
claims.guardrail: Some experimental agent interfaces may help tasks, not required for Google Search.

claims.claim: Cross-origin isolation may interfere with publisher ads
claims.guardrail: Test actual ad tag in chosen origin, avoid universal never-COEP assertion.

claims.claim: Google can restrict ads on pages with low-value publisher content
claims.guardrail: A useful tool does not automatically confer ad eligibility on all states/pages.

claims.claim: Raptive requires at least 25000 monthly pageviews
claims.guardrail: Also minimum domain age, long form content and country mix.

claims.claim: Mediavine Official requires at least 5000 USD annual ad revenue
claims.guardrail: Managed contract has review and editorial/experience requirements.

claims.claim: Every new tool should launch ads on all pages immediately
claims.guardrail: Only approved account and eligible pages; consider ads off critical/download states.

claims.claim: Google publisher EEA UK Swiss traffic requires certified TCF CMP
claims.guardrail: Exact product/region consent settings and law require action-time review.

claims.claim: India law enforcement/fines schedule established by user report
claims.guardrail: Do not certify legal deadlines from a research paste; check official notified rules and counsel.

claims.claim: WCAG 2.2 criteria apply to website accessibility
claims.guardrail: Standard compliance requires comprehensive manual and automated checks.

claims.claim: Pinning a named PDF library version guarantees no exploitable vulnerabilities
claims.guardrail: CVE/advisory versions and transitive dependencies must be reviewed at build time.

claims.claim: All ads should be disabled for detected bots using UA alone
claims.guardrail: Bot identification and vendor policy; cannot trust User-Agent spoof or guarantee IVT prevention.
